propositions: CI intermittently fails authorship batching fixture test during git merge setup with exit code 1, but the asserted content conflict is structurally impossible—both branches write identical bytes to the shared path

The fixture destroys diagnostic evidence by capturing git stderr/stdout then discarding them via CalledProcessError, making the three possible rc=1 causes (content conflict, pre-merge-commit hook failure, unresolvable merge argument) indistinguishable
Approximately 29,400 test executions including 1500 git sequence replays and 3 full test rounds under xdist produced zero reproductions, refuting timing and glob-order theories
The defect is proven to be lost diagnostics when git merge fails; the cause of the original failure remains undetermined and cannot be reproduced
